evidence.quote: Nick Mayor Partner, Head of Research and Portfolio Manager Nick joined Trinity Street in 2017 and has over 25 years of experience in global markets. He was previously a partner at Lancaster Investment Management, a European-focused equity manager, and prior to that a partner at Lansdowne Partners within its Global Developed Markets team. He holds an MPhil in Economics and an MA in Philosophy, Politics and Economics, both from the University of Oxford (Brasenose College).
